top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Trek 100's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At mile 60 of 100, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Trek 100's rolling hills rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Road-specific control matters at Trek 100. Practice on rolling hills: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 100 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Trek 100. Train it until it feels boring.
At Trek 100, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
When someone attacks on rolling hills, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,500ft of climbing on rolling hills does to your power file on race day.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 100 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Trek 100. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
100 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 100 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Trek 100. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Trek 100’s 100 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Trek 100 rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling hills to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Durability, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 100 miles of rolling hills in Trek HQ, 801 West Madison Street, Waterloo, Wisconsin 53594.
